news.headline: Q4 FY26: PAT Rs 146.6 cr (+23.6% YoY), revenue Rs 646.8 cr (+19.6%); final dividend Rs 1/share; Anish Sarin appointed whole-time director
Subsidiary Anant Raj Cloud signs MoU with Andhra Pradesh to invest Rs 4,500 cr in data centre + IT park (two phases); targets 117 MW by FY28, 357 MW by FY32
Launches Rs 1,100 cr QIP at floor price Rs 695.83/share for data-centre and project expansion
